tasks.label: RJ Staging Check Audit
args: SELECT current_database() AS database, current_user AS connected_user; SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name, t.relname AS table_name, c.conname, pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid, false) AS definition FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = c.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = $q$public$q$ AND c.contype = $q$c$q$ ORDER BY t.relname, c.conname;
